### iliad-145 (23.192–286)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| Βορέης · Ζέφυρος (23.195, 23.208) | "the North Wind" · "the West Wind" | same | "Boreas", "Zephyr"; the Odyssey table's four-winds row (5.295–296) |
| Ζέφυρος δυσαής (Ζεφύροιο δυσαέος, 23.200) | "the ill-blowing West Wind" | "the ill-blowing West Wind" | the Odyssey table's row (5.295, 12.289), unchanged |
| Ζέφυρον κελαδεινόν (23.208) | "the resounding West Wind" | "the resounding West Wind" | "loud-voiced", "roaring"; κελαδεινός keeps the table's "resounding" (16.183, of Artemis) |
| μετάγγελος (23.199) | "as go-between messenger" | "went quickly to the winds as a go-between messenger" | "as a messenger" alone (loses μετά), "a messenger between" (clumsy); compound of μετά and ἄγγελος, as the glossary has it |
| ἀθρόοι (23.200) | "all together" | "all together" | "in a close mass" (kept for ἀολλέες); the table's ἀθρόοι ὧδε (2.439) |
| εἰλαπίνην δαίνυντο (23.201) | "a banquet were feasting" | "feasting at a banquet" | "held a feast"; the table's εἰλαπίνη "banquet" (Odyssey 11.415) |
| ἣ δ’ αὖθ’ ἕζεσθαι μὲν ἀνήνατο, εἶπε δὲ μῦθον (23.204, whole-line speech introduction) | "but she in turn rejected sitting down, and spoke a word:" | "But she rejected the invitation to sit down, and spoke a word:" | "refused" (kept for ἀποείπῃ / ἀπεῖπον; the table gives ἀναίνομαι "reject", 9.510, 11.647), "said", "a message"; μῦθος "word" as in the table (18.391) |
| οὐχ ἕδος (23.205) | "No sitting" | "There is no sitting for me" | "No time to sit", "I will not sit" (each decides the reason); ἕδος "seat, sitting" |
| Αἰθιόπων ἐς γαῖαν (23.206) | "to the land of the Ethiopians" | "to the land of the Ethiopians" | "Aethiopians"; no table row |
| μεταδαίσομαι ἱρῶν (23.207) | "may share in the offerings" | "may share in the offerings" | "feast on the sacrifices", "have my share of the meat"; ἱρά = ἱερά "sacrifices, offerings" |
| ἣ μὲν ἄρ’ ὣς εἰποῦσ’ ἀπεβήσετο (23.212, whole half-line) | "She indeed then, so having spoken, went away," | "So she spoke and went away," | follows the table's ἀπεβήσετο (2.35) and the published ἣ μὲν ἄρ’ ὣς εἰποῦσ’ ἀπέβη … Ἶρις (iliad-050) |
| νέφεα κλονέοντε (23.213, dual) | "throwing the clouds into confusion" | "throwing the clouds into confusion" | "driving the clouds", "tossing"; κλονέω "throw into confusion" (5.8, 5.96) |
| ἠχῇ θεσπεσίῃ (23.213) | "with a wondrous din" | "with a wondrous din" | "divine", "marvellous"; θεσπέσιος keeps "wondrous" |
| πόντον ἵκανον ἀήμεναι (23.214) | "the open-sea they reached to blow" | "came to the open sea, blowing" | "sea" alone; πόντος keeps the table's "open-sea" / "open sea" |
| Τροίην ἐρίβωλον (23.215) | "rich-clodded Troy" | "rich-soiled Troy" | "fertile", "deep-soiled"; the table's ἐρίβωλος row (9.329) |
| παννύχιοι · πάννυχος (23.217, 23.218) | "all night long" | "all night long" | "sleepless", "through the night" |
| πυρῆς φλόγ’ ἔβαλλον (23.217) | "were hurling the flame of the pyre" | "kept tossing the pyre’s flame" | "fanned the flame" (supplies the sense), "struck"; βάλλω "throw" |
| ὠκὺς Ἀχιλλεύς (23.218, without πόδας) | "swift Achilles" | "swift Achilles" | "swift-footed" (ποδάρκης), "swift of foot" (πόδας ὠκύς); ὠκύς alone is "swift" |
| ψυχὴν κικλήσκων Πατροκλῆος δειλοῖο (23.221) | "calling on the soul of miserable Patroclus" | "calling on the soul of miserable Patroclus" | "poor", "wretched" (reserved for δύστηνος); δειλός "miserable" |
| νυμφίου (23.223) | "a bridegroom" | "a bridegroom" | "young bridegroom", "newly wed", "groom"; νυμφίος "bridegroom" |
| ἁδινὰ στεναχίζων (23.225) | "groaning heavily" | "groaning heavily" | the table's row (Odyssey 24.317), unchanged |
| ἑρπύζων (23.225) | "creeping" | "crawling" | "dragging himself", "stumbling"; ἑρπύζω "creep" |
| ἑωσφόρος (23.226) | "the dawn-bringer" | "the dawn-bringer" (+ note: the morning star) | "morning star" in `l` (explains rather than translates), "Lucifer", "herald of dawn" |
| φόως ἐρέων (23.226) | "to tell of light" | "to tell of light" | "to announce the light", "bringing light"; ἐρέω "say, tell" (the table's ἀγγελίην ἐρέων 11.652, 355) |
| κροκόπεπλος … ἠώς (23.227) | "saffron-robed Dawn" | "saffron-robed Dawn" | the Odyssey table's κροκόπεπλος (8.1, 19.1), unchanged |
| Θρηΐκιον κατὰ πόντον (23.230) | "over the Thracian open-sea" | "across the Thracian sea" | "Thracian main"; κατά with the accusative "over, across" |
| οἴδματι θύων (23.230) | "raging with a swell" | "surging with a swell" | "swollen", "foaming"; οἶδμα "swell", θύω "rush, rage" |
| κεκμηώς (23.232) | "weary" | "worn out" | "exhausted"; perfect participle of κάμνω |
| γλυκὺς ὕπνος (23.232) | "sweet sleep" | "sweet sleep" | "pleasant sleep"; the table's note that γλυκὺς ὕπνος is "sweet sleep" in English too (Odyssey 2.71) |
| ἀολλέες ἠγερέθοντο (23.233) | "in a close mass were gathering" | "were gathering in a close mass" | "all together" (kept for ἀθρόοι); the table's ἀολλέες (5.498) |
| ὅμαδος καὶ δοῦπος (23.234) | "the din and the thud" | "the uproar and the thud" | the table's row (9.573), unchanged |
| ἕζετο δ’ ὀρθωθεὶς καί σφεας πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπεν (23.235, whole-line speech introduction) | "and he sat, having raised himself upright, and spoke a word to them:" | "He sat up and spoke a word to them:" | "rose and said"; follows iliad-059 (καί σφεας πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε) for the second half |
| αἴθοπι οἴνῳ (23.237, 23.250) | "fire-faced wine" | "wine that has the look of fire" | "gleaming", "sparkling"; the table's αἴθοπα οἶνον (4.259) |
| πυρὸς μένος (23.238) | "the might of the fire" | "the might of the fire" | "force of the fire", "power"; the table's μένος "might" |
| λέγωμεν (ὀστέα, 23.239) | "let us gather" | "let us gather up" | "let us tell", "count"; λέγω in its old sense "pick out, gather" |
| ἀριφραδέα (23.240) | "very plain" | "very plain" | "easy to tell", "very clear" (loses ἀρι-); the table’s ἀριφραδής "very plain" (Odyssey 11.126) |
| ἐπιμίξ (23.242) | "in confusion" | "in confusion" | the table's row (11.537), unchanged |
| δίπλαξ δημός (δίπλακι δημῷ, 23.243; δίπλακα δημόν, 23.253) | "double fat" | "in a double layer of fat" | "folded fat", "twofold" (picks the fold); δημός "fat" |
| φιάλη (23.243, 23.253, 23.270) | "bowl" | "bowl" | "phial" (an English word with a different meaning), "cup" (reserved for δέπας), "libation-bowl" |
| Ἄϊδι κεύθωμαι (23.244) | "am hidden in Hades" | "am hidden in Hades" | "lie hidden", "am buried"; κεύθω "hide" |
| τύμβον … πονέεσθαι (23.245) | "a mound … labour at" | "a mound … labour at" | "tomb" (kept for σῆμα, the table's 2.814), "barrow", "grave-mound"; τύμβος "mound" |
| ἐπιεικέα τοῖον (23.246) | "a fitting one, of such a kind" | "one of fitting measure" | "moderate", "modest"; ἐπιεικής "fitting" |
| ἐσχατιῇ (23.242) | "at the edge" | "at the edge" | the table's ἐπ’ ἐσχατιῇ (9.182), unchanged |
| πολυκλήϊσι νήεσσι (23.248) | "many-thwarted ships" | "ships of many thwarts" | the table's πολυκλήϊσι (2.74, 2.175), unchanged |
| ὣς ἔφαθ’, οἳ δ’ ἐπίθοντο ποδώκεϊ Πηλεΐωνι (23.249, whole-line) | "So he spoke, and they obeyed the fleet-footed son of Peleus." | "So he spoke, and they obeyed the fleet-footed son of Peleus." | "swift-footed" (ποδάρκης), "swift of foot" (πόδας ὠκύς); follows the table's ποδώκης Πηλεΐων (8.474) |
| ἑτάροιο ἐνηέος (23.252) | "of their kindly companion" | "of their kindly companion" | "gentle" (kept for ἤπιος, 23.281); the table's ἐνηής "kindly" (8.200) |
| ἑανῷ λιτὶ κάλυψαν (23.254) | "with fine linen they covered it" | "covered it with fine linen" | unchanged from the shipped iliad-119 (18.352) |
| τορνώσαντο δὲ σῆμα (23.255) | "marked out a tomb" | "marked out the tomb" | "turned", "rounded off"; τορνόω from τόρνος; σῆμα "tomb" (the table's 2.814) |
| θεμείλια προβάλοντο (23.255) | "laid foundations" | "laid its foundations" | "built a kerb", "set a ring of stones" (each decides what the foundations were) |
| χυτὴν ἐπὶ γαῖαν ἔχευαν (23.256) | "poured-earth over it they poured" | "heaped the earth over it" | "poured out"; follows the Odyssey's χυτὴν ἐπὶ γαῖαν ἔχευαν (3.258) "heaped" in `i` and the table's ἐπὶ σῆμ’ ἔχεεν (6.419) |
| χεύαντες δὲ τὸ σῆμα (23.257) | "having poured up the tomb" | "when they had heaped up the tomb" | "built the mound"; χέω "pour" in `l`, "heap" in `i` as in the table (6.419) |
| εὐρὺν ἀγῶνα (23.258) · ἐν ἀγῶνι (23.273) | "a wide gathering" · "in the gathering" | "a wide gathering" · "in the gathering" | "arena", "ring", "the field of the games"; ἀγών "gathering" (the table's 7.298, 19.42), the note says the place is where the people sit |
| ἄεθλα (prizes, 23.259, 23.262, 23.273) | "contest-prizes" | "prizes" | "games" (reserved for the contest sense); follows the table's ἀέθλια "contest-prizes … prizes" (9.124) |
| βοῶν ἴφθιμα κάρηνα (23.260) | "the mighty heads of oxen" | "the mighty heads of cattle" | "strong oxen"; ἴφθιμος "mighty", κάρηνα "heads" (the table keeps "heads") |
| ἱππεῦσιν … ποδώκεσιν (23.262) | "for the horsemen, the fleet-footed ones" | "for the fleet-footed horsemen" | "swift charioteers"; ποδώκης "fleet-footed" carried to the riders (the note says so) |
| ἀγλά’ ἄεθλα (23.262) | "splendid contest-prizes" | "splendid prizes" | "glorious", "shining"; ἀγλαός "splendid" |
| ἄγεσθαι (γυναῖκα, 23.263) | "to lead away" | "to take home" | "to carry off"; middle "to lead for oneself" |
| ἀμύμονα ἔργα ἰδυῖαν (23.263) | "knowing blameless works" | "skilled in blameless crafts" | "faultless", "peerless"; the Odyssey table’s ἀμύμονα ἔργα ἰδυῖα (24.278) "knowing blameless works" / "skilled in blameless crafts" |
| τρίποδ’ ὠτώεντα δυωκαιεικοσίμετρον (23.264) | "an eared tripod of twenty-two measures" | "an eared tripod of twenty-two measures" | "with handles" (a gloss, in the note), "holding twenty-two measures" |
| ἵππον … ἑξέτε’ ἀδμήτην βρέφος ἡμίονον κυέουσαν (23.265–266) | "a mare six years old, untamed, pregnant with a mule’s young" | "a six-year-old mare, unbroken, with a mule’s young in her" | "in foal by a mule"; ἀδμής "untamed", the literal root (the table, 6.109, keeps it for the note) |
| ἄπυρον … λέβητα (23.267) | "an unfired cauldron" | "a fine cauldron, unfired" | "new", "never used"; the table's ἄπυρος "unfired" (9.122) |
| λευκὸν ἔτ’ αὔτως (23.268) | "still white just as it was" | "still white just as it was" | "bright", "unblackened"; λευκός "white" |
| δύω χρυσοῖο τάλαντα (23.269) | "two talents of gold" | "two talents of gold" | "two bars", "weights"; the note says the Homeric talent’s size is not known |
| ἀμφίθετον (φιάλην, 23.270; meaning not known) | "both-sides-set" | "of the ‘both-sides-set’ kind" (+ note: meaning not known) | "two-handled" (silently picks a guess), "double-based", "with a lid"; ἀμφί + θετός, the English keeps its parts |
| ἀπύρωτον (23.270) | "untouched by fire" | "untouched by fire" | "unfired" (kept for ἄπυρος); the table avoided "untouched by fire" for ἄπυρος, so it goes here |
| στῆ δ’ ὀρθὸς καὶ μῦθον ἐν Ἀργείοισιν ἔειπεν (23.271, whole-line speech introduction) | "and he stood upright and spoke a word among the Argives:" | "He stood up straight and spoke a word among the Argives:" | "addressed the Argives"; Ἀργεῖοι "Argives" kept |
| ἱππῆας … δεδεγμένα κεῖτ’ (23.273) | "lie awaiting" the horsemen | "are lying … waiting for the horsemen" | "have been set for", "are offered to"; δέχομαι "receive, await" |
| ἐπὶ ἄλλῳ ἀεθλεύοιμεν (23.274) | "contending in contests for another man" | "holding these contests for some other man" | "for another cause"; ἀεθλεύω "contend in contests" (the table's 4.389) |
| κλισίην δέ (23.275) | "to my hut" | "to my hut" | "to my tent", "to my ship"; κλισίη "hut" with the ending -δε of motion towards |
| ἀρετῇ περιβάλλετον ἵπποι (23.276) | "in excellence … surpass" | "surpass the others in excellence" | "in valour", "in virtue"; ἀρετή "excellence" (the table’s 8.535, 11.763) |
| ἐγγυάλιξεν (23.278) | "put into my hands" | "put them into my hands" | "gave" (kept for πόρε); the table’s ἐγγυαλίζω (11.753, 17.613) |
| μώνυχες ἵπποι (23.279) | "the solid-hoofed horses" | "the solid-hoofed horses" | the table's row (5.236), unchanged |
| κλέος ἐσθλόν (23.280) | "good glory" | "good glory" | "good renown", "noble fame", "fair repute"; the table’s κλέος ἐσθλόν "good glory" (5.273, 17.143) |
| ἡνιόχοιο ἠπίου (23.280–281) | "a charioteer, a gentle one" | "a charioteer, a gentle man" | "kindly" (reserved for ἐνηής); ἤπιος "gentle" as in the table (4.218, 6.251) |
| ὑγρὸν ἔλαιον (23.281) | "liquid oil" | "liquid oil" | "soft oil", "moist"; the table's ἔλαιον "olive oil" is for the full phrase, here the adjective ὑγρός "liquid" |
| χαιτάων κατέχευε λοέσσας ὕδατι λευκῷ (23.282) | "poured down on their manes, having washed them with white water" | "poured liquid oil down on the manes … after washing them with clear water" | "bright water", "fresh water"; λοέω "wash" (10.577), λευκός "white" in `l` and "clear" in `i`, the note says so |
| πενθείετον (23.283, dual) | "mourn" | "stand and mourn" | "lament" (reserved for ὀδύρομαι); πενθέω "mourn" |
| οὔδεϊ … χαῖται ἐρηρέδαται (23.283–284) | "to the ground … manes are fixed" | "manes are pressed to the ground" | "trail", "droop"; ἐρείδω "prop, press" |
| ἀχνυμένω κῆρ (23.284) | "grieving in heart" | "grieving at heart" | "sorrowing"; the table's ἀχνυμένη "grieving" (11.388) and κῆρ "in heart" |
| στέλλεσθε κατὰ στρατόν (23.285) | "get yourselves ready throughout the army" | "make ready throughout the army" | "go to your places", "set out" (each decides the sense); στέλλω "make ready" |
| ἅρμασι κολλητοῖσιν (23.286) | "a well-joined chariot" | "his well-joined chariot" | "glued", "well-fitted", "chariots"; the table’s ἅρμασι κολλητοῖσιν "a well-joined chariot" (plural for one vehicle, Odyssey 17.117; Iliad 11.197) |
